data.name: Hasiyah
data.gender_notes: Hasiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Hasiyah means 'gift' or 'present'. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, 'Give gifts to each other,' emphasizing the importance of generosity and kindness towards others. The name Hasiyah carries the meaning “Gift, Present” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hasiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, present and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's blessings and kindness towards us
data.etymology: Hasiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Present.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hasiyah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hasiyah holds significant cultural importance in Islamic societies. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) emphasized the importance of giving gifts and acts of kindness towards others in various Hadiths. He said, “Give gifts to each other,” encouraging Muslims to practice generosity, kindness, and goodwill amongst one another. This value is deeply ingrained in Islamic culture and reflected in various traditions and celebrations.
data.spiritual_significance: Hasiyah also holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims, reminding us of the Prophet's teachings of humility, kindness, and love towards others.
